description: Searches Big Red Cloud customer help across Freshdesk support articles, customer documentation, recorded webinar videos and upcoming webinars. Returns a synthesized answer, ordered guidance and public source metadata. Read-only and available without a connected company.

category.description: Optional help category filter, for example bank_feeds or sales.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching resources to return. Defaults to 5.

question.description: Plain-English help question, for example how do bank feeds work or how do I reconcile my bank account.

source.description: Optional source filter: freshdesk, customer_docs, recorded_webinar, youtube_video, upcoming_webinar, or all.

name: brc_find_help_resources
title: Find Help Resources
